page.layout: One block of text on one printed page: woodcut ornament heading at top, title in large capitals and italic/roman lines, then a paragraph opening with a woodcut initial C, running to the foot. No margin notes. Page number 2 printed at the foot left of the last line; catchword/signature not visible.
page.notes: The woodcut initial C is joined to "Ogitanti" as printed; the title block is set in mixed roman and italic, with "Domino." in italic. The first heading lines are rendered as a level 1 head; the top border is an ornament, not text. Line "meorum, cuiuscunque demum ij" ends with a half-word "ij" followed by "sint" on the last line; "2" is a signature mark at the foot, left of "sint". Some letters in the title (e.g. "Scotorum") are slightly blurred.
